listing.name: Burnout Revenge (Xbox 360) — Xerenge (shipa-2)
listing.summary: The project claims European and USA builds are playable through races and Crash mode. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Burnout Revenge (Xbox 360) Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. Europe or USA, each with matching native game build.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the region-specific Linux or macOS setup. The source preparation builds the SDK and game locally; some installers instead include regional runtimes.

warnings: The project claims European and USA builds are playable through races and Crash mode.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
